input.summary: Build Bonus X with the upper-right three-bank, use the right spinner and upper-left collect area to build and collect bonus, and keep the upper-right flipper raised and unused.

quickInfo.name: Base bonus
quickInfo.summary: Lanes, the spinner, small slings, and selected targets build base bonus to 19,000.

quickInfo.name: Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Each upper-right three-bank completion advances Bonus X through 2x, 3x, and 5x.

quickInfo.name: Collect Bonus
quickInfo.summary: The upper-left saucer collects base bonus, resets its value, and keeps the current multiplier for the rest of the ball.

quickInfo.name: Return-lane boost
quickInfo.summary: The standup below the left top lane raises each return lane to 5,000 and three bonus advances.

quickInfo.name: Skill shot
quickInfo.summary: The top rollover raises both outside top lanes from 3,000 to 9,000 before the ball enters one of them.

steps.text: Plunge across the small top rollover. Guide the ball into the lit right outside lane when the nudge is safe.
Use the left flipper to shoot the upper-right three-bank. Complete it until Bonus X reaches 5x.
Use the right spinner and the lanes beside the bumpers to build base bonus toward 19,000.
Send the ball through the gap below the upper-left saucer. Nudge for a bumper rebound into Collect Bonus.
modeNotes: Collect Bonus: The saucer scores the current base bonus at the current multiplier. Base bonus resets, but Bonus X remains for the ball.

steps.text: If the standup below the left top lane is available from that rebound, hit it to improve return-lane scoring before returning to the Bonus X and Collect Bonus route.
Rebuild base bonus through the spinner and top area. Collect it again while 5x remains active.
Keep the upper-right flipper raised during nearby action. Do not use it for normal shots.

fallback.title: Spinner and top play
fallback.when: Use this when the right drop bank or Collect Bonus rebound is too dangerous.

steps.text: Repeat the right spinner from the left flipper.
Use the top lanes and bumpers to build bonus.
Collect a partial bonus only after the saucer feed becomes controlled.
Avoid the far outside-left shot and the upper-right flipper.
Complete the upper-right three-bank until Bonus X reaches 5x.
Shoot the right spinner, return lanes, outlanes, upper slings, or other bonus-advance switches until base bonus reaches 19,000.
Use a bumper rebound or bank shot to enter Collect Bonus.
Rebuild and collect base bonus again before the ball ends.

playfieldReferences.label: Collect Bonus saucer
playfieldReferences.description: The upper-left saucer that scores the current base bonus at the current multiplier.

playfieldReferences.label: Bonus X three-bank
playfieldReferences.description: The upper-right drop-target bank whose completions advance Bonus X through 2x, 3x, and 5x.

techniques.name: Collect Bonus rebound
techniques.instruction: Shoot through the gap below the saucer. Nudge so the left bumper sends the ball into the saucer.

techniques.name: Drop-bank bank shot
techniques.instruction: Use the upper-right drop bank as a bank surface when a direct Collect Bonus entry is not available.

cautions.issue: Bumper exits and target rebounds can move to the center drain.
cautions.response: Use controlled outside shots. Nudge early while the ball is still above the lower slingshots.

cautions.issue: The upper-right flipper can send rebounds toward the left outlane.
cautions.response: Keep that flipper raised as a guide. Do not flip with it during normal play.

cautions.issue: A missing center-post rubber makes center drains more common.
cautions.response: Check the center post before play. Reduce target risk if the post or its rubber is missing.

input.simpleOverview: Nugent uses the upper-right three-bank to raise Bonus X and an upper-left saucer to collect the built base bonus without resetting that multiplier. Reach 5x, build toward 19,000, collect at the saucer, then rebuild and collect again during the same ball.
input.overview: Nugent uses the upper-right three-bank to raise Bonus X and an upper-left saucer to collect the built base bonus without resetting that multiplier. Complete the bank first, then feed bonus through the right side and use a bumper rebound or controlled bank shot for the collect. Rebuild before the ball ends and leave the upper-right flipper raised rather than using it.
